text:
Lending accounts may arrange a voluntary loan recall, but recall is not a condition for this vote.
Disclosure of the underlying beneficial owner is mandatory to exercise voting rights.
The holder need not satisfy a certificate confirming holdings to vote.
A power of attorney is available as an optional convenience; holders can vote without it.
The agent confirms that a restriction on split voting does not apply to this event.
Only holders with professional-investor status may cast votes.
The current general meeting offers eligible shareholders a proxy ballot.
Registration for the webcast is optional and is not required for proxy voting.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 24 November 2026 at 17:00 UTC.
Meeting venue directions and transport details are supplied for convenience; this paragraph does not impose an attendance condition.

Shareholders may lodge their votes on the meeting resolutions through their custodian.

text:
The current general meeting offers eligible shareholders a proxy ballot.
The holder must identify its ultimate beneficial owner before the voting agent will accept a ballot.
Voting participation is conditional on the holder satisfying the additional professional-investor qualification.
Pre-registration with the voting agent is mandatory for this holder.
Beneficial owners wishing to vote are obliged to deliver a power of attorney.
An investor may voluntarily freeze its position, but lodging a vote never blocks the shares.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 24 November 2026 at 17:00 UTC.
Security descriptions may be abbreviated in account statements. The issuer legal name remains unchanged.

passage_spans.text: Voting instructions are invited for the forthcoming shareholder assembly.
The agent confirms that a certificate confirming holdings does not apply to this event.
Providing the ultimate owner name is voluntary; anonymous voting instructions remain accepted.
The service accepts votes without imposing the additional professional-investor voting restriction.
The account cannot split its votes between different choices.
The current terms expressly waive recall of securities on loan.
The voting balance is frozen against transfers once a ballot is lodged.
Beneficial owners wishing to vote are obliged to deliver a power of attorney.
Registration for the webcast is optional and is not required for proxy voting.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 24 November 2026 at 17:00 UTC.
The board report contains a discussion of historical performance, remuneration and the outlook for the business.

text:
Voting instructions are accepted only after the holder has completed the separate registration procedure.

A separate professional-investor eligibility restriction applies to voting.

The current terms expressly waive a restriction on split voting.

A certificate of holdings must accompany each set of voting instructions.

Shareholders may lodge their votes on the meeting resolutions through their custodian.

Beneficial owners wishing to vote are obliged to deliver a power of attorney.

A holder who instructs a vote cannot sell the instructed position before the meeting ends.

Disclosure of the underlying beneficial owner is mandatory to exercise voting rights.

Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 24 November 2026 at 17:00 UTC.

The agenda and annual accounts are available from the issuer. Requests for paper copies are administrative and optional.

text:
The custodian requires a separate registration request as a condition of voting.
Only holders with professional-investor status may cast votes.
A holder who instructs a vote cannot sell the instructed position before the meeting ends.
The current terms expressly waive recall of securities on loan.
Shareholders may lodge their votes on the meeting resolutions through their custodian.
A power of attorney is available as an optional convenience; holders can vote without it.
The account cannot split its votes between different choices.
Votes will be rejected unless the position is evidenced by a dated holding confirmation.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 24 November 2026 at 17:00 UTC.
Meeting venue directions and transport details are supplied for convenience; this paragraph does not impose an attendance condition.

text:
Lending accounts may arrange a voluntary loan recall, but recall is not a condition for this vote.
A holdings certificate may be supplied voluntarily, but no proof of ownership is required with the ballot.
No share blocking is required for voting.
The account must register its voting participation before it may cast votes.
The current general meeting offers eligible shareholders a proxy ballot.
Providing the ultimate owner name is voluntary; anonymous voting instructions remain accepted.
All shares in a voting account must be voted in the same way; split voting is prohibited.
Beneficial owners wishing to vote are obliged to deliver a power of attorney.
Only holders with professional-investor status may cast votes.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 24 November 2026 at 17:00 UTC.
Cash entitlements are reconciled separately by the income department. The payment currency has no bearing on proxy instructions.

passage_spans.text: Voting investors must bring lent shares back from the borrower before voting.
Registration for the webcast is optional and is not required for proxy voting.
A holdings certificate may be supplied voluntarily, but no proof of ownership is required with the ballot.
A power of attorney is available as an optional convenience; holders can vote without it.
Professional-investor registration is an optional service; retail holders can vote without it.
Different voting directions within one account are not permitted.
The holder must identify its ultimate beneficial owner before the voting agent will accept a ballot.
Voting instructions are invited for the forthcoming shareholder assembly.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 24 November 2026 at 17:00 UTC.
Please use the event reference when discussing document delivery.
The contact centre cannot amend an instruction by telephone.

text:

Voting is available without share blocking.

Shareholders may lodge their votes on the meeting resolutions through their custodian.
The voting agent requires documentary proof of the account holdings.

Registration for the webcast is optional and is not required for proxy voting.

Retail holders are excluded from voting under the stated additional eligibility rule.

Professional-investor registration is an optional service; retail holders can vote without it.

Voting instructions are invited for the forthcoming shareholder assembly.

No a restriction on split voting is required for voting.

Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 24 November 2026 at 17:00 UTC.

The telephone service handles settlement queries during normal business hours; this does not change the voting channel.

Voting instructions are invited for the forthcoming shareholder assembly.

text:
No the additional professional-investor voting restriction is required for voting.
The service accepts votes without imposing beneficial-owner identity disclosure.
A power of attorney is available as an optional convenience; holders can vote without it.
Submitting proxy votes prevents disposal of the corresponding securities until the meeting concludes.
There is no requirement for recall of securities on loan under the current voting terms.
Voting instructions are accepted only after the holder has completed the separate registration procedure.
The agent has not established whether a certificate confirming holdings is mandatory for this vote; confirmation is pending.
Shareholders may lodge their votes on the meeting resolutions through their custodian.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 24 November 2026 at 17:00 UTC.
Please use the event reference when discussing document delivery. The contact centre cannot amend an instruction by telephone.

Voting is available without recall of securities on loan.

Disclosure of the underlying beneficial owner is mandatory to exercise voting rights.

Shareholders may lodge their votes on the meeting resolutions through their custodian.

Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 24 November 2026 at 17:00 UTC.

text:
Registration for the webcast is optional and is not required for proxy voting.
A holdings certificate may be supplied voluntarily, but no proof of ownership is required with the ballot.
Voting instructions are invited for the forthcoming shareholder assembly.
The holder must identify its ultimate beneficial owner before the voting agent will accept a ballot.
The holder need not satisfy a power of attorney to vote.
A holder may choose one direction for all shares or split them freely; no uniform-vote requirement applies.
The service accepts votes without imposing recall of securities on loan.
Professional-investor registration is an optional service; retail holders can vote without it.
The service accepts votes without imposing share blocking.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 24 November 2026 at 17:00 UTC.
The safekeeping account reference should be included in routine correspondence to facilitate matching.

passage_spans.text: A formal power of attorney is a mandatory prerequisite for this account to vote.
The account must register its voting participation before it may cast votes.
No the additional professional-investor voting restriction is required for voting.
Providing the ultimate owner name is voluntary; anonymous voting instructions remain accepted.
A holder may choose one direction for all shares or split them freely; no uniform-vote requirement applies.
The voting agent requires documentary proof of the account holdings.
Voting investors must bring lent shares back from the borrower before voting.
Voting instructions are invited for the forthcoming shareholder assembly.
The voting balance is frozen against transfers once a ballot is lodged.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 24 November 2026 at 17:00 UTC.
Administrative information: copies may be retained in the client document archive under the usual retention schedule.

text:
Securities currently on loan must be recalled to exercise the voting rights.

The agent rejects proxy instructions unless a valid power of attorney accompanies them.

Providing the ultimate owner name is voluntary; anonymous voting instructions remain accepted.

Votes will be rejected unless the position is evidenced by a dated holding confirmation.

A holder who instructs a vote cannot sell the instructed position before the meeting ends.

The custodian requires a separate registration request as a condition of voting.

There is no requirement for the additional professional-investor voting restriction under the current voting terms.

A holder may choose one direction for all shares or split them freely; no uniform-vote requirement applies.

Shareholders may lodge their votes on the meeting resolutions through their custodian.

Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 24 November 2026 at 17:00 UTC.

The agenda and annual accounts are available from the issuer. Requests for paper copies are administrative and optional.

passage_spans.text: Voting investors must bring lent shares back from the borrower before voting.
There is no requirement for a certificate confirming holdings under the current voting terms.
Voting instructions are invited for the forthcoming shareholder assembly.
Only holders with professional-investor status may cast votes.
Voting instructions are accepted only after the holder has completed the separate registration procedure.
The agent has not established whether share blocking is mandatory for this vote; confirmation is pending.
A power of attorney is available as an optional convenience; holders can vote without it.
The agent accepts only one voting direction for the entire instructed balance.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 24 November 2026 at 17:00 UTC.
The safekeeping account reference should be included in routine correspondence to facilitate matching.

text:
Shareholders may lodge their votes on the meeting resolutions through their custodian.

The holder need not satisfy a certificate confirming holdings to vote.

The custodian requires the lending account to recall its securities before lodging a ballot.

The agent has not established whether share blocking is mandatory for this vote; confirmation is pending.

Voting instructions are accepted only after the holder has completed the separate registration procedure.

A power of attorney is available as an optional convenience; holders can vote without it.

Only holders with professional-investor status may cast votes.

Different voting directions within one account are not permitted.

Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 24 November 2026 at 17:00 UTC.

Meeting venue directions and transport details are supplied for convenience; this paragraph does not impose an attendance condition.

text:
Shareholders may lodge their votes on the meeting resolutions through their custodian.
A certificate of holdings must accompany each set of voting instructions.
Registration for the webcast is optional and is not required for proxy voting.
Securities currently on loan must be recalled to exercise the voting rights.
Providing the ultimate owner name is voluntary; anonymous voting instructions remain accepted.
Beneficial owners wishing to vote are obliged to deliver a power of attorney.
The account is expressly exempt from share blocking.
The holder need not satisfy the additional professional-investor voting restriction to vote.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 24 November 2026 at 17:00 UTC.
The intermediary maintains separate operational records for pending trades and reconciles unmatched settlements daily.

passage_spans.text: Voting investors must bring lent shares back from the borrower before voting.
Different voting directions within one account are not permitted.
The holder need not satisfy the additional professional-investor voting restriction to vote.
Shareholders may lodge their votes on the meeting resolutions through their custodian.
Voting is conditional on delivery of the beneficial owner name and identity details.
Submission of an ownership certificate is compulsory for voting.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 24 November 2026 at 17:00 UTC.
The safekeeping account reference should be included in routine correspondence to facilitate matching.

The telephone service handles settlement queries during normal business hours; this does not change the voting channel.

text:
No a power of attorney is required for voting.
The account is expressly exempt from recall of securities on loan.
Voting instructions are invited for the forthcoming shareholder assembly.
Registration for the webcast is optional and is not required for proxy voting.

Professional-investor registration is an optional service; retail holders can vote without it.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 24 November 2026 at 17:00 UTC.
Meeting venue directions and transport details are supplied for convenience; this paragraph does not impose an attendance condition.

Beneficial owners wishing to vote are obliged to deliver a power of attorney.
The agent accepts only one voting direction for the entire instructed balance.
The agent confirms that a certificate confirming holdings does not apply to this event.
Disclosure of the underlying beneficial owner is mandatory to exercise voting rights.
The current terms expressly waive additional voting registration.
Professional-investor registration is an optional service; retail holders can vote without it.
Lending accounts may arrange a voluntary loan recall, but recall is not a condition for this vote.
An investor may voluntarily freeze its position, but lodging a vote never blocks the shares.
Voting instructions are invited for the forthcoming shareholder assembly.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 24 November 2026 at 17:00 UTC.
Administrative information: copies may be retained in the client document archive under the usual retention schedule.

text:
The current terms expressly waive a certificate confirming holdings.

An investor may voluntarily freeze its position, but lodging a vote never blocks the shares.

Different voting directions within one account are not permitted.

Professional-investor registration is an optional service; retail holders can vote without it.

The account is expressly exempt from additional voting registration.

Shareholders may lodge their votes on the meeting resolutions through their custodian.

Voting is conditional on delivery of the beneficial owner name and identity details.

Lending accounts may arrange a voluntary loan recall, but recall is not a condition for this vote.

The agent rejects proxy instructions unless a valid power of attorney accompanies them.

Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 24 November 2026 at 17:00 UTC.

The intermediary maintains separate operational records for pending trades and reconciles unmatched settlements daily.

The custodian requires a separate registration request as a condition of voting.

A holder who instructs a vote cannot sell the instructed position before the meeting ends.
The current terms expressly waive recall of securities on loan.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 24 November 2026 at 17:00 UTC.

text:
Voting instructions are invited for the forthcoming shareholder assembly.

Registration for the webcast is optional and is not required for proxy voting.

The holder need not satisfy a restriction on split voting to vote.

The current terms expressly waive recall of securities on loan.

The voting balance is frozen against transfers once a ballot is lodged.

A power of attorney is available as an optional convenience; holders can vote without it.

Providing the ultimate owner name is voluntary; anonymous voting instructions remain accepted.

A separate professional-investor eligibility restriction applies to voting.

Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 24 November 2026 at 17:00 UTC.

Cash entitlements are reconciled separately by the income department. The payment currency has no bearing on proxy instructions.

text:
The agent confirms that the additional professional-investor voting restriction does not apply to this event.

The service accepts votes without imposing beneficial-owner identity disclosure.

The voting agent requires documentary proof of the account holdings.

Voting instructions are invited for the forthcoming shareholder assembly.

A power of attorney is available as an optional convenience; holders can vote without it.

The custodian requires a separate registration request as a condition of voting.

Recall of the loaned position is a mandatory prerequisite for this investor to vote.

The holder need not satisfy share blocking to vote.

Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 24 November 2026 at 17:00 UTC.

Cash entitlements are reconciled separately by the income department. The payment currency has no bearing on proxy instructions.

text:

The account must register its voting participation before it may cast votes.
The holder need not satisfy beneficial-owner identity disclosure to vote.

There is no requirement for a certificate confirming holdings under the current voting terms.
The current general meeting offers eligible shareholders a proxy ballot.
Securities currently on loan must be recalled to exercise the voting rights.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 24 November 2026 at 17:00 UTC.

text:
A holdings certificate may be supplied voluntarily, but no proof of ownership is required with the ballot.

The service accepts votes without imposing the additional professional-investor voting restriction.

There is no requirement for a restriction on split voting under the current voting terms.

A formal power of attorney is a mandatory prerequisite for this account to vote.

A holder who instructs a vote cannot sell the instructed position before the meeting ends.

The holder must identify its ultimate beneficial owner before the voting agent will accept a ballot.

Shareholders may lodge their votes on the meeting resolutions through their custodian.

The holder need not satisfy recall of securities on loan to vote.

Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 24 November 2026 at 17:00 UTC.

Cash entitlements are reconciled separately by the income department. The payment currency has no bearing on proxy instructions.

passage_spans.text: A holdings certificate may be supplied voluntarily, but no proof of ownership is required with the ballot.
Voting instructions are invited for the forthcoming shareholder assembly.
There is no requirement for recall of securities on loan under the current voting terms.
The service accepts votes without imposing share blocking.
Voting instructions are accepted only after the holder has completed the separate registration procedure.
Votes cannot be lodged without a signed power-of-attorney document.
Disclosure of the underlying beneficial owner is mandatory to exercise voting rights.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 24 November 2026 at 17:00 UTC.
The agenda and annual accounts are available from the issuer.
Requests for paper copies are administrative and optional.

text:
The current general meeting offers eligible shareholders a proxy ballot.
The service accepts votes without imposing recall of securities on loan.
The service accepts votes without imposing a restriction on split voting.
The account must register its voting participation before it may cast votes.
Submitting proxy votes prevents disposal of the corresponding securities until the meeting concludes.
Voting is conditional on delivery of the beneficial owner name and identity details.
Beneficial owners wishing to vote are obliged to deliver a power of attorney.
Voting participation is conditional on the holder satisfying the additional professional-investor qualification.
The agent has not established whether a certificate confirming holdings is mandatory for this vote; confirmation is pending.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 24 November 2026 at 17:00 UTC.
Meeting venue directions and transport details are supplied for convenience; this paragraph does not impose an attendance condition.

text:
Anonymous voting instructions are rejected: the beneficial owner identity must be disclosed.

Only holders with professional-investor status may cast votes.

The agent has not established whether a certificate confirming holdings is mandatory for this vote; confirmation is pending.

The account is expressly exempt from recall of securities on loan.

Pre-registration with the voting agent is mandatory for this holder.

The holder need not satisfy a restriction on split voting to vote.

Voting instructions immobilise the instructed shares until the close of the meeting.

Votes cannot be lodged without a signed power-of-attorney document.

Shareholders may lodge their votes on the meeting resolutions through their custodian.

Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 24 November 2026 at 17:00 UTC.

The telephone service handles settlement queries during normal business hours; this does not change the voting channel.

The current general meeting offers eligible shareholders a proxy ballot.
The account is expressly exempt from recall of securities on loan.
The agent has not established whether additional voting registration is mandatory for this vote; confirmation is pending.

text:
Voting instructions are invited for the forthcoming shareholder assembly.
A holdings certificate may be supplied voluntarily, but no proof of ownership is required with the ballot.
The account cannot split its votes between different choices.
Voting is available without recall of securities on loan.
The holder must identify its ultimate beneficial owner before the voting agent will accept a ballot.
A power of attorney is available as an optional convenience; holders can vote without it.
Only holders with professional-investor status may cast votes.
Voting is available without additional voting registration.
Voting instructions immobilise the instructed shares until the close of the meeting.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 24 November 2026 at 17:00 UTC.

passage_spans.text: Voting participation is conditional on the holder satisfying the additional professional-investor qualification.
Pre-registration with the voting agent is mandatory for this holder.
The voting balance is frozen against transfers once a ballot is lodged.
There is no requirement for recall of securities on loan under the current voting terms.
The holder must identify its ultimate beneficial owner before the voting agent will accept a ballot.
Different voting directions within one account are not permitted.
The current general meeting offers eligible shareholders a proxy ballot.

Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 24 November 2026 at 17:00 UTC.
Administrative information: copies may be retained in the client document archive under the usual retention schedule.

A holdings certificate may be supplied voluntarily, but no proof of ownership is required with the ballot.

text:
The voting balance is frozen against transfers once a ballot is lodged.
A holdings certificate may be supplied voluntarily, but no proof of ownership is required with the ballot.
Registration for the webcast is optional and is not required for proxy voting.

Disclosure of the underlying beneficial owner is mandatory to exercise voting rights.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 24 November 2026 at 17:00 UTC.

passage_spans.text: Disclosure of the underlying beneficial owner is mandatory to exercise voting rights.
No recall of securities on loan is required for voting.
Retail holders are excluded from voting under the stated additional eligibility rule.
An investor may voluntarily freeze its position, but lodging a vote never blocks the shares.
Shareholders may lodge their votes on the meeting resolutions through their custodian.
The holder need not satisfy additional voting registration to vote.
Submission of an ownership certificate is compulsory for voting.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 24 November 2026 at 17:00 UTC.
Meeting venue directions and transport details are supplied for convenience; this paragraph does not impose an attendance condition.

text:
An investor may voluntarily freeze its position, but lodging a vote never blocks the shares.

Only holders with professional-investor status may cast votes.

Submission of an ownership certificate is compulsory for voting.

No additional voting registration is required for voting.

The holder must identify its ultimate beneficial owner before the voting agent will accept a ballot.

Voting instructions are invited for the forthcoming shareholder assembly.

No recall of securities on loan is required for voting.

Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 24 November 2026 at 17:00 UTC.

Cash entitlements are reconciled separately by the income department. The payment currency has no bearing on proxy instructions.

text:
Professional-investor registration is an optional service; retail holders can vote without it.

Registration for the webcast is optional and is not required for proxy voting.
Votes will be rejected unless the position is evidenced by a dated holding confirmation.
Voting investors must bring lent shares back from the borrower before voting.
Submitting proxy votes prevents disposal of the corresponding securities until the meeting concludes.
The holder need not satisfy beneficial-owner identity disclosure to vote.
Voting participation is conditional on the holder satisfying the additional professional-investor qualification.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 24 November 2026 at 17:00 UTC.
The telephone service handles settlement queries during normal business hours; this does not change the voting channel.

passage_spans.text: Shareholders may lodge their votes on the meeting resolutions through their custodian.
Beneficial owners wishing to vote are obliged to deliver a power of attorney.
Professional-investor registration is an optional service; retail holders can vote without it.
A holdings certificate may be supplied voluntarily, but no proof of ownership is required with the ballot.
The agent confirms that a restriction on split voting does not apply to this event.
Lending accounts may arrange a voluntary loan recall, but recall is not a condition for this vote.
Disclosure of the underlying beneficial owner is mandatory to exercise voting rights.
The voting balance is frozen against transfers once a ballot is lodged.
The custodian requires a separate registration request as a condition of voting.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 24 November 2026 at 17:00 UTC.
The board report contains a discussion of historical performance, remuneration and the outlook for the business.

text:
Submission of an ownership certificate is compulsory for voting.
All shares in a voting account must be voted in the same way; split voting is prohibited.
Professional-investor registration is an optional service; retail holders can vote without it.
The current terms expressly waive share blocking.
The current general meeting offers eligible shareholders a proxy ballot.
Voting is conditional on delivery of the beneficial owner name and identity details.
The service accepts votes without imposing recall of securities on loan.
A power of attorney is available as an optional convenience; holders can vote without it.
Registration for the webcast is optional and is not required for proxy voting.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 24 November 2026 at 17:00 UTC.
Please use the event reference when discussing document delivery. The contact centre cannot amend an instruction by telephone.

passage_spans.text: Submission of an ownership certificate is compulsory for voting.
All shares in a voting account must be voted in the same way; split voting is prohibited.
Professional-investor registration is an optional service; retail holders can vote without it.
The current terms expressly waive share blocking.
The current general meeting offers eligible shareholders a proxy ballot.
Voting is conditional on delivery of the beneficial owner name and identity details.
The service accepts votes without imposing recall of securities on loan.
A power of attorney is available as an optional convenience; holders can vote without it.
Registration for the webcast is optional and is not required for proxy voting.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 24 November 2026 at 17:00 UTC.
Please use the event reference when discussing document delivery.
The contact centre cannot amend an instruction by telephone.

text:

The account cannot split its votes between different choices.

Votes will be rejected unless the position is evidenced by a dated holding confirmation.

The service accepts votes without imposing recall of securities on loan.

Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 24 November 2026 at 17:00 UTC.

Meeting venue directions and transport details are supplied for convenience; this paragraph does not impose an attendance condition.

text:
The agent rejects proxy instructions unless a valid power of attorney accompanies them.
The current general meeting offers eligible shareholders a proxy ballot.
A separate professional-investor eligibility restriction applies to voting.
No recall of securities on loan is required for voting.
Submitting proxy votes prevents disposal of the corresponding securities until the meeting concludes.
The account cannot split its votes between different choices.
Providing the ultimate owner name is voluntary; anonymous voting instructions remain accepted.
The account must register its voting participation before it may cast votes.
The voting agent requires documentary proof of the account holdings.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 24 November 2026 at 17:00 UTC.
The safekeeping account reference should be included in routine correspondence to facilitate matching.

Votes cannot be lodged without a signed power-of-attorney document.

Professional-investor registration is an optional service; retail holders can vote without it.

Providing the ultimate owner name is voluntary; anonymous voting instructions remain accepted.

The current general meeting offers eligible shareholders a proxy ballot.

Pre-registration with the voting agent is mandatory for this holder.

Recall of the loaned position is a mandatory prerequisite for this investor to vote.

A holder may choose one direction for all shares or split them freely; no uniform-vote requirement applies.

Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 24 November 2026 at 17:00 UTC.

The agenda and annual accounts are available from the issuer. Requests for paper copies are administrative and optional.

passage_spans.text: The account is expressly exempt from the additional professional-investor voting restriction.
Beneficial owners wishing to vote are obliged to deliver a power of attorney.
The agent accepts only one voting direction for the entire instructed balance.
The voting balance is frozen against transfers once a ballot is lodged.
Lending accounts may arrange a voluntary loan recall, but recall is not a condition for this vote.

Shareholders may lodge their votes on the meeting resolutions through their custodian.
Pre-registration with the voting agent is mandatory for this holder.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 24 November 2026 at 17:00 UTC.
Administrative information: copies may be retained in the client document archive under the usual retention schedule.

text:

Recall of the loaned position is a mandatory prerequisite for this investor to vote.

Administrative information: copies may be retained in the client document archive under the usual retention schedule.

A separate professional-investor eligibility restriction applies to voting.

Voting instructions immobilise the instructed shares until the close of the meeting.

Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 24 November 2026 at 17:00 UTC.

passage_spans.text: Voting instructions are invited for the forthcoming shareholder assembly.
A separate professional-investor eligibility restriction applies to voting.
The account is expressly exempt from beneficial-owner identity disclosure.
A holdings certificate may be supplied voluntarily, but no proof of ownership is required with the ballot.
Voting investors must bring lent shares back from the borrower before voting.
Voting instructions are accepted only after the holder has completed the separate registration procedure.
Voting instructions immobilise the instructed shares until the close of the meeting.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 24 November 2026 at 17:00 UTC.
The telephone service handles settlement queries during normal business hours; this does not change the voting channel.

text:
Voting instructions are accepted only after the holder has completed the separate registration procedure.
Only holders with professional-investor status may cast votes.
The agent has not established whether beneficial-owner identity disclosure is mandatory for this vote; confirmation is pending.
The account cannot split its votes between different choices.
Shareholders may lodge their votes on the meeting resolutions through their custodian.
The voting balance is frozen against transfers once a ballot is lodged.
There is no requirement for recall of securities on loan under the current voting terms.
A power of attorney is available as an optional convenience; holders can vote without it.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 24 November 2026 at 17:00 UTC.
The safekeeping account reference should be included in routine correspondence to facilitate matching.

text:

Professional-investor registration is an optional service; retail holders can vote without it.

text:
Retail holders are excluded from voting under the stated additional eligibility rule.
The voting balance is frozen against transfers once a ballot is lodged.
Registration for the webcast is optional and is not required for proxy voting.
The account cannot split its votes between different choices.
The agent confirms that beneficial-owner identity disclosure does not apply to this event.
A holdings certificate may be supplied voluntarily, but no proof of ownership is required with the ballot.
The service accepts votes without imposing recall of securities on loan.
Shareholders may lodge their votes on the meeting resolutions through their custodian.
Votes cannot be lodged without a signed power-of-attorney document.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 24 November 2026 at 17:00 UTC.
The telephone service handles settlement queries during normal business hours; this does not change the voting channel.

passage_spans.text: The current general meeting offers eligible shareholders a proxy ballot.
The current terms expressly waive share blocking.
Votes will be rejected unless the position is evidenced by a dated holding confirmation.
The holder need not satisfy beneficial-owner identity disclosure to vote.
Pre-registration with the voting agent is mandatory for this holder.
Voting participation is conditional on the holder satisfying the additional professional-investor qualification.
The custodian requires the lending account to recall its securities before lodging a ballot.
A holder may choose one direction for all shares or split them freely; no uniform-vote requirement applies.
The agent rejects proxy instructions unless a valid power of attorney accompanies them.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 24 November 2026 at 17:00 UTC.
The agenda and annual accounts are available from the issuer.
Requests for paper copies are administrative and optional.

text:
A power of attorney is available as an optional convenience; holders can vote without it.
A holder may choose one direction for all shares or split them freely; no uniform-vote requirement applies.
Shareholders may lodge their votes on the meeting resolutions through their custodian.
The agent has not established whether beneficial-owner identity disclosure is mandatory for this vote; confirmation is pending.
Registration for the webcast is optional and is not required for proxy voting.
Voting participation is conditional on the holder satisfying the additional professional-investor qualification.
Submission of an ownership certificate is compulsory for voting.
The voting balance is frozen against transfers once a ballot is lodged.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 24 November 2026 at 17:00 UTC.
Administrative information: copies may be retained in the client document archive under the usual retention schedule.

passage_spans.text: Shareholders may lodge their votes on the meeting resolutions through their custodian.
There is no requirement for a restriction on split voting under the current voting terms.
A certificate of holdings must accompany each set of voting instructions.
The agent confirms that the additional professional-investor voting restriction does not apply to this event.
Anonymous voting instructions are rejected: the beneficial owner identity must be disclosed.

The board report contains a discussion of historical performance, remuneration and the outlook for the business.

text:
Registration for the webcast is optional and is not required for proxy voting.
Voting participation is conditional on the holder satisfying the additional professional-investor qualification.
All shares in a voting account must be voted in the same way; split voting is prohibited.
The current general meeting offers eligible shareholders a proxy ballot.
A holder who instructs a vote cannot sell the instructed position before the meeting ends.
The agent confirms that beneficial-owner identity disclosure does not apply to this event.
The custodian requires the lending account to recall its securities before lodging a ballot.
Submission of an ownership certificate is compulsory for voting.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 24 November 2026 at 17:00 UTC.
The agenda and annual accounts are available from the issuer. Requests for paper copies are administrative and optional.

passage_spans.text: The current terms expressly waive recall of securities on loan.
A holdings certificate may be supplied voluntarily, but no proof of ownership is required with the ballot.
Professional-investor registration is an optional service; retail holders can vote without it.
Shareholders may lodge their votes on the meeting resolutions through their custodian.
Providing the ultimate owner name is voluntary; anonymous voting instructions remain accepted.
There is no requirement for additional voting registration under the current voting terms.
The service accepts votes without imposing a restriction on split voting.
The agent has not established whether share blocking is mandatory for this vote; confirmation is pending.
A formal power of attorney is a mandatory prerequisite for this account to vote.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 24 November 2026 at 17:00 UTC.
Meeting venue directions and transport details are supplied for convenience; this paragraph does not impose an attendance condition.

text:
The service accepts votes without imposing recall of securities on loan.
The agent confirms that a restriction on split voting does not apply to this event.
The holder must identify its ultimate beneficial owner before the voting agent will accept a ballot.
Voting instructions are invited for the forthcoming shareholder assembly.
A power of attorney is available as an optional convenience; holders can vote without it.
An investor may voluntarily freeze its position, but lodging a vote never blocks the shares.
A holdings certificate may be supplied voluntarily, but no proof of ownership is required with the ballot.
Only holders with professional-investor status may cast votes.
Registration for the webcast is optional and is not required for proxy voting.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 24 November 2026 at 17:00 UTC.
Cash entitlements are reconciled separately by the income department. The payment currency has no bearing on proxy instructions.

Anonymous voting instructions are rejected: the beneficial owner identity must be disclosed.
Registration for the webcast is optional and is not required for proxy voting.
Voting participation is conditional on the holder satisfying the additional professional-investor qualification.
The account is expressly exempt from a restriction on split voting.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 24 November 2026 at 17:00 UTC.
The board report contains a discussion of historical performance, remuneration and the outlook for the business.

text:
The current general meeting offers eligible shareholders a proxy ballot.
No a power of attorney is required for voting.
There is no requirement for share blocking under the current voting terms.
Disclosure of the underlying beneficial owner is mandatory to exercise voting rights.
The account cannot split its votes between different choices.
Voting is available without a certificate confirming holdings.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 24 November 2026 at 17:00 UTC.
Please use the event reference when discussing document delivery. The contact centre cannot amend an instruction by telephone.

text:
A power of attorney is available as an optional convenience; holders can vote without it.
The agent has not established whether additional voting registration is mandatory for this vote; confirmation is pending.
An investor may voluntarily freeze its position, but lodging a vote never blocks the shares.
The agent accepts only one voting direction for the entire instructed balance.
The current general meeting offers eligible shareholders a proxy ballot.
Voting is conditional on delivery of the beneficial owner name and identity details.
Lending accounts may arrange a voluntary loan recall, but recall is not a condition for this vote.
Votes will be rejected unless the position is evidenced by a dated holding confirmation.
Retail holders are excluded from voting under the stated additional eligibility rule.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 24 November 2026 at 17:00 UTC.
The agenda and annual accounts are available from the issuer. Requests for paper copies are administrative and optional.

passage_spans.text: Only holders with professional-investor status may cast votes.
The account is expressly exempt from additional voting registration.
The service accepts votes without imposing a power of attorney.
The current general meeting offers eligible shareholders a proxy ballot.
The voting balance is frozen against transfers once a ballot is lodged.
The custodian requires the lending account to recall its securities before lodging a ballot.
A holder may choose one direction for all shares or split them freely; no uniform-vote requirement applies.
Voting is conditional on delivery of the beneficial owner name and identity details.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 24 November 2026 at 17:00 UTC.
Meeting venue directions and transport details are supplied for convenience; this paragraph does not impose an attendance condition.

text:
The holder need not satisfy share blocking to vote.
No recall of securities on loan is required for voting.
Pre-registration with the voting agent is mandatory for this holder.
The current terms expressly waive a restriction on split voting.
There is no requirement for a power of attorney under the current voting terms.
Votes will be rejected unless the position is evidenced by a dated holding confirmation.
Shareholders may lodge their votes on the meeting resolutions through their custodian.
Providing the ultimate owner name is voluntary; anonymous voting instructions remain accepted.
The account is expressly exempt from the additional professional-investor voting restriction.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 24 November 2026 at 17:00 UTC.
The telephone service handles settlement queries during normal business hours; this does not change the voting channel.

Providing the ultimate owner name is voluntary; anonymous voting instructions remain accepted.

Voting instructions are invited for the forthcoming shareholder assembly.

The current terms expressly waive recall of securities on loan.

A power of attorney is available as an optional convenience; holders can vote without it.

The agent accepts only one voting direction for the entire instructed balance.

Registration for the webcast is optional and is not required for proxy voting.

An investor may voluntarily freeze its position, but lodging a vote never blocks the shares.

Submission of an ownership certificate is compulsory for voting.

Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 24 November 2026 at 17:00 UTC.

Security descriptions may be abbreviated in account statements. The issuer legal name remains unchanged.

text:
Shareholders may lodge their votes on the meeting resolutions through their custodian.
Professional-investor registration is an optional service; retail holders can vote without it.
A certificate of holdings must accompany each set of voting instructions.
Registration for the webcast is optional and is not required for proxy voting.
Beneficial owners wishing to vote are obliged to deliver a power of attorney.
Providing the ultimate owner name is voluntary; anonymous voting instructions remain accepted.
The custodian requires the lending account to recall its securities before lodging a ballot.
Submitting proxy votes prevents disposal of the corresponding securities until the meeting concludes.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 24 November 2026 at 17:00 UTC.
The board report contains a discussion of historical performance, remuneration and the outlook for the business.

passage_spans.text: Beneficial owners wishing to vote are obliged to deliver a power of attorney.
The voting balance is frozen against transfers once a ballot is lodged.
The service accepts votes without imposing the additional professional-investor voting restriction.
Lending accounts may arrange a voluntary loan recall, but recall is not a condition for this vote.
A holder may choose one direction for all shares or split them freely; no uniform-vote requirement applies.
The agent confirms that a certificate confirming holdings does not apply to this event.
The current general meeting offers eligible shareholders a proxy ballot.
The current terms expressly waive additional voting registration.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 24 November 2026 at 17:00 UTC.
Administrative information: copies may be retained in the client document archive under the usual retention schedule.

text:
Voting is conditional on delivery of the beneficial owner name and identity details.
A holdings certificate may be supplied voluntarily, but no proof of ownership is required with the ballot.
An investor may voluntarily freeze its position, but lodging a vote never blocks the shares.
Shareholders may lodge their votes on the meeting resolutions through their custodian.
Retail holders are excluded from voting under the stated additional eligibility rule.
A power of attorney is available as an optional convenience; holders can vote without it.
Recall of the loaned position is a mandatory prerequisite for this investor to vote.
The account must register its voting participation before it may cast votes.
All shares in a voting account must be voted in the same way; split voting is prohibited.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 24 November 2026 at 17:00 UTC.
The board report contains a discussion of historical performance, remuneration and the outlook for the business.

A holder may choose one direction for all shares or split them freely; no uniform-vote requirement applies.

Voting is available without a certificate confirming holdings.

Securities currently on loan must be recalled to exercise the voting rights.

The current general meeting offers eligible shareholders a proxy ballot.

The account is expressly exempt from share blocking.

A separate professional-investor eligibility restriction applies to voting.

Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 24 November 2026 at 17:00 UTC.
The intermediary maintains separate operational records for pending trades and reconciles unmatched settlements daily.

text:

The account must register its voting participation before it may cast votes.

text:
A power of attorney is available as an optional convenience; holders can vote without it.
The custodian requires a separate registration request as a condition of voting.

The custodian requires the lending account to recall its securities before lodging a ballot.

Voting instructions immobilise the instructed shares until the close of the meeting.

Professional-investor registration is an optional service; retail holders can vote without it.

Voting instructions are invited for the forthcoming shareholder assembly.

Pre-registration with the voting agent is mandatory for this holder.

The account cannot split its votes between different choices.

The holder need not satisfy a power of attorney to vote.

Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 24 November 2026 at 17:00 UTC.

The telephone service handles settlement queries during normal business hours; this does not change the voting channel.

text:
Voting participation is conditional on the holder satisfying the additional professional-investor qualification.
An investor may voluntarily freeze its position, but lodging a vote never blocks the shares.
The agent confirms that recall of securities on loan does not apply to this event.
Providing the ultimate owner name is voluntary; anonymous voting instructions remain accepted.
A power of attorney is available as an optional convenience; holders can vote without it.
Shareholders may lodge their votes on the meeting resolutions through their custodian.
A holdings certificate may be supplied voluntarily, but no proof of ownership is required with the ballot.
The custodian requires a separate registration request as a condition of voting.
A holder may choose one direction for all shares or split them freely; no uniform-vote requirement applies.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 24 November 2026 at 17:00 UTC.
The safekeeping account reference should be included in routine correspondence to facilitate matching.

A power of attorney is available as an optional convenience; holders can vote without it.

Providing the ultimate owner name is voluntary; anonymous voting instructions remain accepted.

Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 24 November 2026 at 17:00 UTC.

The telephone service handles settlement queries during normal business hours; this does not change the voting channel.

The account cannot split its votes between different choices.

Voting is available without recall of securities on loan.

text:
The custodian requires the lending account to recall its securities before lodging a ballot.
The account is expressly exempt from share blocking.
Only holders with professional-investor status may cast votes.

A holdings certificate may be supplied voluntarily, but no proof of ownership is required with the ballot.
The current general meeting offers eligible shareholders a proxy ballot.
Anonymous voting instructions are rejected: the beneficial owner identity must be disclosed.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 24 November 2026 at 17:00 UTC.

Voting instructions are accepted only after the holder has completed the separate registration procedure.

The account cannot split its votes between different choices.

Shareholders may lodge their votes on the meeting resolutions through their custodian.
Lending accounts may arrange a voluntary loan recall, but recall is not a condition for this vote.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 24 November 2026 at 17:00 UTC.

text:
Submission of an ownership certificate is compulsory for voting.

The account cannot split its votes between different choices.

An investor may voluntarily freeze its position, but lodging a vote never blocks the shares.

Voting instructions are invited for the forthcoming shareholder assembly.

The account must register its voting participation before it may cast votes.

Lending accounts may arrange a voluntary loan recall, but recall is not a condition for this vote.

Beneficial owners wishing to vote are obliged to deliver a power of attorney.

Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 24 November 2026 at 17:00 UTC.

Cash entitlements are reconciled separately by the income department. The payment currency has no bearing on proxy instructions.

The account cannot split its votes between different choices.

text:
The account is expressly exempt from share blocking.
The custodian requires the lending account to recall its securities before lodging a ballot.
The current general meeting offers eligible shareholders a proxy ballot.
The holder must identify its ultimate beneficial owner before the voting agent will accept a ballot.
Voting instructions are accepted only after the holder has completed the separate registration procedure.
The holder need not satisfy a restriction on split voting to vote.
A formal power of attorney is a mandatory prerequisite for this account to vote.
The current terms expressly waive a certificate confirming holdings.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 24 November 2026 at 17:00 UTC.
The telephone service handles settlement queries during normal business hours; this does not change the voting channel.

text:
No a restriction on split voting is required for voting.

The custodian requires a separate registration request as a condition of voting.

There is no requirement for the additional professional-investor voting restriction under the current voting terms.

Voting is conditional on delivery of the beneficial owner name and identity details.

Shareholders may lodge their votes on the meeting resolutions through their custodian.

A power of attorney is available as an optional convenience; holders can vote without it.

Voting investors must bring lent shares back from the borrower before voting.

Submission of an ownership certificate is compulsory for voting.

Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 24 November 2026 at 17:00 UTC.

The agenda and annual accounts are available from the issuer. Requests for paper copies are administrative and optional.

Disclosure of the underlying beneficial owner is mandatory to exercise voting rights.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 24 November 2026 at 17:00 UTC.

text:
The current general meeting offers eligible shareholders a proxy ballot.
An investor may voluntarily freeze its position, but lodging a vote never blocks the shares.
A formal power of attorney is a mandatory prerequisite for this account to vote.
The holder must identify its ultimate beneficial owner before the voting agent will accept a ballot.
A holdings certificate may be supplied voluntarily, but no proof of ownership is required with the ballot.
The agent has not established whether additional voting registration is mandatory for this vote; confirmation is pending.
The account is expressly exempt from the additional professional-investor voting restriction.
Securities currently on loan must be recalled to exercise the voting rights.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 24 November 2026 at 17:00 UTC.
Meeting venue directions and transport details are supplied for convenience; this paragraph does not impose an attendance condition.

text:

A holdings certificate may be supplied voluntarily, but no proof of ownership is required with the ballot.
Shareholders may lodge their votes on the meeting resolutions through their custodian.

An investor may voluntarily freeze its position, but lodging a vote never blocks the shares.
The custodian requires a separate registration request as a condition of voting.
A separate professional-investor eligibility restriction applies to voting.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 24 November 2026 at 17:00 UTC.
The safekeeping account reference should be included in routine correspondence to facilitate matching.

The account is expressly exempt from additional voting registration.

text:
Voting instructions are invited for the forthcoming shareholder assembly.
The voting agent requires documentary proof of the account holdings.
The service accepts votes without imposing beneficial-owner identity disclosure.
The account cannot split its votes between different choices.
Voting investors must bring lent shares back from the borrower before voting.
An investor may voluntarily freeze its position, but lodging a vote never blocks the shares.
Retail holders are excluded from voting under the stated additional eligibility rule.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 24 November 2026 at 17:00 UTC.
The agenda and annual accounts are available from the issuer. Requests for paper copies are administrative and optional.

passage_spans.text: Lending accounts may arrange a voluntary loan recall, but recall is not a condition for this vote.
There is no requirement for a restriction on split voting under the current voting terms.
Pre-registration with the voting agent is mandatory for this holder.
Votes will be rejected unless the position is evidenced by a dated holding confirmation.
Professional-investor registration is an optional service; retail holders can vote without it.
Shareholders may lodge their votes on the meeting resolutions through their custodian.
The service accepts votes without imposing a power of attorney.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 24 November 2026 at 17:00 UTC.
The intermediary maintains separate operational records for pending trades and reconciles unmatched settlements daily.

text:
A separate professional-investor eligibility restriction applies to voting.
The account is expressly exempt from recall of securities on loan.
Providing the ultimate owner name is voluntary; anonymous voting instructions remain accepted.
Shareholders may lodge their votes on the meeting resolutions through their custodian.
Submission of an ownership certificate is compulsory for voting.
The current terms expressly waive a power of attorney.
Voting instructions are accepted only after the holder has completed the separate registration procedure.
Voting is available without share blocking.
Different voting directions within one account are not permitted.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 24 November 2026 at 17:00 UTC.
The safekeeping account reference should be included in routine correspondence to facilitate matching.

Voting instructions are invited for the forthcoming shareholder assembly.
Securities currently on loan must be recalled to exercise the voting rights.
Submitting proxy votes prevents disposal of the corresponding securities until the meeting concludes.

Professional-investor registration is an optional service; retail holders can vote without it.

Registration for the webcast is optional and is not required for proxy voting.

Voting instructions immobilise the instructed shares until the close of the meeting.

Shareholders may lodge their votes on the meeting resolutions through their custodian.

Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 24 November 2026 at 17:00 UTC.

The agenda and annual accounts are available from the issuer. Requests for paper copies are administrative and optional.

passage_spans.text: Shareholders may lodge their votes on the meeting resolutions through their custodian.
Professional-investor registration is an optional service; retail holders can vote without it.
The service accepts votes without imposing a restriction on split voting.
The agent rejects proxy instructions unless a valid power of attorney accompanies them.
The current terms expressly waive recall of securities on loan.
The agent confirms that a certificate confirming holdings does not apply to this event.
Submitting proxy votes prevents disposal of the corresponding securities until the meeting concludes.
The account is expressly exempt from additional voting registration.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 24 November 2026 at 17:00 UTC.
The intermediary maintains separate operational records for pending trades and reconciles unmatched settlements daily.

text:
Voting participation is conditional on the holder satisfying the additional professional-investor qualification.
An investor may voluntarily freeze its position, but lodging a vote never blocks the shares.
The current general meeting offers eligible shareholders a proxy ballot.
The agent accepts only one voting direction for the entire instructed balance.
Lending accounts may arrange a voluntary loan recall, but recall is not a condition for this vote.
A formal power of attorney is a mandatory prerequisite for this account to vote.
Anonymous voting instructions are rejected: the beneficial owner identity must be disclosed.
The custodian requires a separate registration request as a condition of voting.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 24 November 2026 at 17:00 UTC.
Security descriptions may be abbreviated in account statements. The issuer legal name remains unchanged.

passage_spans.text: Disclosure of the underlying beneficial owner is mandatory to exercise voting rights.
A holdings certificate may be supplied voluntarily, but no proof of ownership is required with the ballot.
The service accepts votes without imposing additional voting registration.
An investor may voluntarily freeze its position, but lodging a vote never blocks the shares.
Professional-investor registration is an optional service; retail holders can vote without it.
A power of attorney is available as an optional convenience; holders can vote without it.
Shareholders may lodge their votes on the meeting resolutions through their custodian.
Lending accounts may arrange a voluntary loan recall, but recall is not a condition for this vote.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 24 November 2026 at 17:00 UTC.
The intermediary maintains separate operational records for pending trades and reconciles unmatched settlements daily.

text:
The current terms expressly waive beneficial-owner identity disclosure.
Shareholders may lodge their votes on the meeting resolutions through their custodian.
The custodian requires a separate registration request as a condition of voting.
Securities currently on loan must be recalled to exercise the voting rights.
The agent rejects proxy instructions unless a valid power of attorney accompanies them.
Voting is available without a restriction on split voting.
The holder need not satisfy share blocking to vote.
A separate professional-investor eligibility restriction applies to voting.
Votes will be rejected unless the position is evidenced by a dated holding confirmation.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 24 November 2026 at 17:00 UTC.
Cash entitlements are reconciled separately by the income department. The payment currency has no bearing on proxy instructions.

Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 24 November 2026 at 17:00 UTC.

text:

A separate professional-investor eligibility restriction applies to voting.

The account is expressly exempt from recall of securities on loan.
Submitting proxy votes prevents disposal of the corresponding securities until the meeting concludes.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 24 November 2026 at 17:00 UTC.
Please use the event reference when discussing document delivery. The contact centre cannot amend an instruction by telephone.

text:

The holder must identify its ultimate beneficial owner before the voting agent will accept a ballot.
Voting instructions are invited for the forthcoming shareholder assembly.
Voting instructions immobilise the instructed shares until the close of the meeting.

Voting instructions are accepted only after the holder has completed the separate registration procedure.
Voting participation is conditional on the holder satisfying the additional professional-investor qualification.
Beneficial owners wishing to vote are obliged to deliver a power of attorney.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 24 November 2026 at 17:00 UTC.

text:
Voting is conditional on delivery of the beneficial owner name and identity details.

Beneficial owners wishing to vote are obliged to deliver a power of attorney.

Shareholders may lodge their votes on the meeting resolutions through their custodian.

The account is expressly exempt from a restriction on split voting.

A holder who instructs a vote cannot sell the instructed position before the meeting ends.

The service accepts votes without imposing recall of securities on loan.

The custodian requires a separate registration request as a condition of voting.

A separate professional-investor eligibility restriction applies to voting.

Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 24 November 2026 at 17:00 UTC.

The telephone service handles settlement queries during normal business hours; this does not change the voting channel.

text:
The current terms expressly waive additional voting registration.
Voting instructions are invited for the forthcoming shareholder assembly.
The account cannot split its votes between different choices.
A power of attorney is available as an optional convenience; holders can vote without it.
An investor may voluntarily freeze its position, but lodging a vote never blocks the shares.
Providing the ultimate owner name is voluntary; anonymous voting instructions remain accepted.
The holder need not satisfy the additional professional-investor voting restriction to vote.
There is no requirement for a certificate confirming holdings under the current voting terms.
The custodian requires the lending account to recall its securities before lodging a ballot.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 24 November 2026 at 17:00 UTC.
Cash entitlements are reconciled separately by the income department. The payment currency has no bearing on proxy instructions.

Recall of the loaned position is a mandatory prerequisite for this investor to vote.
The account cannot split its votes between different choices.

The service accepts votes without imposing the additional professional-investor voting restriction.

The board report contains a discussion of historical performance, remuneration and the outlook for the business.

Disclosure of the underlying beneficial owner is mandatory to exercise voting rights.
Recall of the loaned position is a mandatory prerequisite for this investor to vote.

Recall of the loaned position is a mandatory prerequisite for this investor to vote.

text:
The custodian requires the lending account to recall its securities before lodging a ballot.
A formal power of attorney is a mandatory prerequisite for this account to vote.
A certificate of holdings must accompany each set of voting instructions.
Disclosure of the underlying beneficial owner is mandatory to exercise voting rights.
Pre-registration with the voting agent is mandatory for this holder.
Professional-investor registration is an optional service; retail holders can vote without it.
The current general meeting offers eligible shareholders a proxy ballot.
The account cannot split its votes between different choices.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 24 November 2026 at 17:00 UTC.
The agenda and annual accounts are available from the issuer. Requests for paper copies are administrative and optional.

passage_spans.text: Shareholders may lodge their votes on the meeting resolutions through their custodian.
Different voting directions within one account are not permitted.
Voting instructions are accepted only after the holder has completed the separate registration procedure.
A certificate of holdings must accompany each set of voting instructions.
Disclosure of the underlying beneficial owner is mandatory to exercise voting rights.
Professional-investor registration is an optional service; retail holders can vote without it.
Beneficial owners wishing to vote are obliged to deliver a power of attorney.
The custodian requires the lending account to recall its securities before lodging a ballot.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 24 November 2026 at 17:00 UTC.
The safekeeping account reference should be included in routine correspondence to facilitate matching.

text:
The agent accepts only one voting direction for the entire instructed balance.
Voting instructions are invited for the forthcoming shareholder assembly.
A holdings certificate may be supplied voluntarily, but no proof of ownership is required with the ballot.
Professional-investor registration is an optional service; retail holders can vote without it.
Votes cannot be lodged without a signed power-of-attorney document.
Anonymous voting instructions are rejected: the beneficial owner identity must be disclosed.
Registration for the webcast is optional and is not required for proxy voting.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 24 November 2026 at 17:00 UTC.
Cash entitlements are reconciled separately by the income department. The payment currency has no bearing on proxy instructions.

passage_spans.text: A certificate of holdings must accompany each set of voting instructions.
The current general meeting offers eligible shareholders a proxy ballot.
Providing the ultimate owner name is voluntary; anonymous voting instructions remain accepted.
All shares in a voting account must be voted in the same way; split voting is prohibited.
The voting balance is frozen against transfers once a ballot is lodged.
Voting participation is conditional on the holder satisfying the additional professional-investor qualification.
No recall of securities on loan is required for voting.
The account must register its voting participation before it may cast votes.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 24 November 2026 at 17:00 UTC.
Security descriptions may be abbreviated in account statements.
The issuer legal name remains unchanged.

text:
Registration for the webcast is optional and is not required for proxy voting.
Disclosure of the underlying beneficial owner is mandatory to exercise voting rights.

The voting balance is frozen against transfers once a ballot is lodged.

Only holders with professional-investor status may cast votes.
The agent accepts only one voting direction for the entire instructed balance.
Voting instructions are invited for the forthcoming shareholder assembly.

Security descriptions may be abbreviated in account statements. The issuer legal name remains unchanged.

text:
The voting balance is frozen against transfers once a ballot is lodged.

Registration for the webcast is optional and is not required for proxy voting.

Retail holders are excluded from voting under the stated additional eligibility rule.

Different voting directions within one account are not permitted.

A holdings certificate may be supplied voluntarily, but no proof of ownership is required with the ballot.

Shareholders may lodge their votes on the meeting resolutions through their custodian.

The agent rejects proxy instructions unless a valid power of attorney accompanies them.

Disclosure of the underlying beneficial owner is mandatory to exercise voting rights.

Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 24 November 2026 at 17:00 UTC.

Cash entitlements are reconciled separately by the income department. The payment currency has no bearing on proxy instructions.

passage_spans.text: Voting is available without the additional professional-investor voting restriction.
The service accepts votes without imposing additional voting registration.
The current general meeting offers eligible shareholders a proxy ballot.

Securities currently on loan must be recalled to exercise the voting rights.

text:

Recall of the loaned position is a mandatory prerequisite for this investor to vote.
Voting instructions immobilise the instructed shares until the close of the meeting.
A holder may choose one direction for all shares or split them freely; no uniform-vote requirement applies.

Voting instructions immobilise the instructed shares until the close of the meeting.

passage_spans.text: Registration for the webcast is optional and is not required for proxy voting.
Only holders with professional-investor status may cast votes.
A holdings certificate may be supplied voluntarily, but no proof of ownership is required with the ballot.
Voting instructions are invited for the forthcoming shareholder assembly.
A holder may choose one direction for all shares or split them freely; no uniform-vote requirement applies.
A power of attorney is available as an optional convenience; holders can vote without it.
Disclosure of the underlying beneficial owner is mandatory to exercise voting rights.
The current terms expressly waive recall of securities on loan.
Voting instructions immobilise the instructed shares until the close of the meeting.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 24 November 2026 at 17:00 UTC.
The board report contains a discussion of historical performance, remuneration and the outlook for the business.

text:
The holder must identify its ultimate beneficial owner before the voting agent will accept a ballot.
Shareholders may lodge their votes on the meeting resolutions through their custodian.
A power of attorney is available as an optional convenience; holders can vote without it.
Lending accounts may arrange a voluntary loan recall, but recall is not a condition for this vote.
The custodian requires a separate registration request as a condition of voting.
Professional-investor registration is an optional service; retail holders can vote without it.
An investor may voluntarily freeze its position, but lodging a vote never blocks the shares.
Votes will be rejected unless the position is evidenced by a dated holding confirmation.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 24 November 2026 at 17:00 UTC.
Meeting venue directions and transport details are supplied for convenience; this paragraph does not impose an attendance condition.
